title: Order lifecycle
goal: Show guarded e-commerce order progression from draft through delivery or cancellation.

rubric.must: An initial marker enters Draft and Delivered and Cancelled visibly terminate at final markers.
Payment Pending visibly branches to Paid and Payment Failed, with retry or cancellation paths.
Cart-valid, stock-available, retry-count, and customer-request guards are visible on transitions.
Paid visibly progresses through Fulfillment and Shipped to Delivered.
Cancellation and delivery outcomes are visually distinct.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: The SVG satisfies all five rules, while the picture omits required payment branches, guards, and Fulfillment.
